entries.speaker: Dr. Linzer

entries.text: Run whatever tests you need if you don't believe me.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I don't need to run any tests. Smallpox has an eight-day incubation period, and these kids were stung a few hours ago. How do you reconcile that?
entries.speaker: Dr. Linzer

entries.text: I can't.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ shouting ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ chattering ] excuse me.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Let me know when you come up with an answer. In the meantime, I've got things to do.
entries.speaker: Dr. Linzer

entries.text: Doctor!
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Mr. Skinner?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: How do you know who I am?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Because you contacted me. I'm Marita Covarrubias.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: What are you doing here?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Your call about those bees prompted me to make inquiries.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: Into what?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Seven packages that were sent from Canada... To a p.o. Box in payson, south carolina. I came here to find out what was in those packages.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: You're a little late to do anything about it.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: So are you, apparently. What brought you here? You came to me for information, mr. Skinner, but you still haven't told me what you know about this. My office has to answer to the secretary general of the united nations. This is a very serious matter. I need to know what's going on.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: I think it's some kind of experiment.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: An experiment?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: Using bees as carriers.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: And that's what was in those packages? Have you told agent Mulder this?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: Not yet.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Why not?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: I can't.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Why? Are you involved in this, mr. Skinner?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: I didn't-- no, I'm not involved.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Then what are you doing here? What aren't you telling me, mr. Skinner?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: Nothing.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: If you know who's behind this, you have to come forward, mr. Skinner. No one else can.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: Put the gun down and move away from the desk.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I was just calling--
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I said put the gun down!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ sighs ] you don't understand.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: No. I do now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, you don't.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Is that the gun you used to shoot the detective?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: How does it feel to shoot an innocent man in the head?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I didn't kill him!
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You're a liar! You've been working with the smoking man all along. You knew when he had my father killed, and you knew when they took Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Listen to me.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I've heard enough of you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He set me up! He stole my gun! Then he put it back. Which means the police are probably on their way right now.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I don't believe you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Look at my desk drawer, agent Mulder. Look at it! Why would I force my own lock? If I lied to you-- I have lied to you, and I won't make excuses for those lies. But there's a reason I did what I did-- one that I think you're in a unique position to understand. I advised you against a certain course of action some time ago... Concerning agent Scully. I didn't follow my own advice.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Give me the gun. How soon will you be able to determine if that's the weapon that killed detective thomas?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: As long as it takes me to put one of these slugs into a scope and run a comp. This is the slug we recovered from the detective's body. You see this stria here and here? They're rifling patterns, imprinted from the barrel of the same gun.
entries.speaker: Ballistics Tech

entries.text: So this is definitely the murder weapon?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: If I were called to testify, I'd say without a doubt. So where'd you find it?
entries.speaker: Ballistics Tech

entries.text: In a sewer grate, around the corner from the crime scene.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mm.
entries.speaker: Ballistics Tech

entries.text: Sometimes you get lucky.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Sometimes you don't, right?
entries.speaker: Ballistics Tech

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The serial number-- it's been filed clean off. Now, unless forensics pulled a print, this gun's virtually untraceable.
entries.speaker: Ballistics Tech

entries.text: Leave it off. I'm starting to get used to the dark.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Is this part of our deal?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: We never had a deal.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: No?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Agent Scully is dying, and you haven't done a thing. You think that's funny?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Just enjoying the irony, mr. Skinner. Only yesterday you said you wouldn't be party to murder. And now here you are. Yours isn't the first gun I've had pointed in my face, mr. Skinner. I'm not afraid to die. But if you kill me now, you'll also kill agent Scully.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You have no intention of saving her. You never did.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Are you certain? I saved her life once before when I had her returned to agent Mulder. I may save her life again. But you'll never know if you pull the trigger, will you?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ phone ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Now, unless you intend to kill me, I'd like to answer my phone.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ ringing continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ ringing continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ ringing continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Yes. He was just here. He threatened to kill me. I'm sure Mulder will be contacting you. He'll want to know if Skinner has seen all there is to see.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I'll tell him what you want me to tell him.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias

entries.text: Tell him what he wants to hear.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
